name: Greater Beastkin
description: (Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Greater Beastkin, half beast and half whatever you are. You gain superhuman physical abilities and enhanced natural senses and instincts. You gain more affinity for nature-based abilities and spells, letting you use them more effectively. Your beast side is powerful too; even simple cat claws are tough as iron. (Chosen beast is decided by the writer, not an in-story choice)
